schemas.wms_material_lot_inventory_decision:
wms_material_lot_inventory_decision	CREATE TABLE `wms_material_lot_inventory_decision` (
  `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `org_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `created_by` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(3),
  `material_lot_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `previous_decision_id` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `action` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `previous_inventory_status` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `resulting_inventory_status` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `reason` varchar(1000) NOT NULL,
  `decided_by` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `decided_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `signature_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `signature_evidence_json` longtext NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_inventory_predecessor` (`org_id`,`previous_decision_id`),
  KEY `material_lot_id` (`material_lot_id`),
  KEY `previous_decision_id` (`previous_decision_id`),
  KEY `decided_by` (`decided_by`),
  KEY `signature_id` (`signature_id`),
  KEY `ix_wms_material_lot_inventory_decision_root` (`org_id`,`material_lot_id`,`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `1` FOREIGN KEY (`material_lot_id`) REFERENCES `md_material_lot` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `2` FOREIGN KEY (`previous_decision_id`) REFERENCES `wms_material_lot_inventory_decision` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `3` FOREIGN KEY (`decided_by`) REFERENCES `sys_user` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `4` FOREIGN KEY (`signature_id`) REFERENCES `gxp_signature` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `CONSTRAINT_1` CHECK (json_valid(`signature_evidence_json`)),
  CONSTRAINT `CONSTRAINT_2` CHECK (`action` in ('FREEZE','UNFREEZE')),
  CONSTRAINT `CONSTRAINT_3` CHECK (`action` = 'FREEZE' and `previous_inventory_status` = 'AVAILABLE' and `resulting_inventory_status` = 'FROZEN' or `action` = 'UNFREEZE' and `previous_inventory_status` = 'FROZEN' and `resulting_inventory_status` = 'AVAILABLE')
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=30 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci

schemas.qms_ipc_instance:
qms_ipc_instance	CREATE TABLE `qms_ipc_instance` (
  `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `org_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `created_by` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(3),
  `updated_by` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(3),
  `version_no` bigint(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `operation_execution_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `ipc_code` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `result` varchar(30) DEFAULT NULL,
  `completed_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `definition_snapshot_json` longtext NOT NULL,
  `current_result_revision_id` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_ipc_operation_code` (`org_id`,`operation_execution_id`,`ipc_code`),
  KEY `operation_execution_id` (`operation_execution_id`),
  KEY `ix_qms_ipc_instance_root` (`org_id`,`operation_execution_id`,`id`),
  KEY `current_result_revision_id` (`current_result_revision_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `1` FOREIGN KEY (`operation_execution_id`) REFERENCES `mes_operation_execution` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `2` FOREIGN KEY (`current_result_revision_id`) REFERENCES `qms_ipc_result_revision` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `CONSTRAINT_1` CHECK (json_valid(`definition_snapshot_json`)),
  CONSTRAINT `CONSTRAINT_2` CHECK (`status` in ('PENDING','TESTING','COMPLETED')),
  CONSTRAINT `CONSTRAINT_3` CHECK (`result` is null or `result` in ('PASS','FAIL','INVALID'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=16 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci
schemas.qms_ipc_result_revision:
qms_ipc_result_revision	CREATE TABLE `qms_ipc_result_revision` (
  `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `org_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `created_by` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(3),
  `ipc_instance_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `revision_no` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `previous_revision_id` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `result_numeric` decimal(24,8) DEFAULT NULL,
  `result_text` varchar(1000) DEFAULT NULL,
  `result_conclusion` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `definition_snapshot_json` longtext NOT NULL,
  `reason_for_change` varchar(1000) DEFAULT NULL,
  `recorded_by` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `recorded_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `signature_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `signature_evidence_json` longtext NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_ipc_revision` (`org_id`,`ipc_instance_id`,`revision_no`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_ipc_predecessor` (`org_id`,`previous_revision_id`),
  KEY `ipc_instance_id` (`ipc_instance_id`),
  KEY `previous_revision_id` (`previous_revision_id`),
  KEY `recorded_by` (`recorded_by`),
  KEY `signature_id` (`signature_id`),
  KEY `ix_qms_ipc_result_revision_root` (`org_id`,`ipc_instance_id`,`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `1` FOREIGN KEY (`ipc_instance_id`) REFERENCES `qms_ipc_instance` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `2` FOREIGN KEY (`previous_revision_id`) REFERENCES `qms_ipc_result_revision` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `3` FOREIGN KEY (`recorded_by`) REFERENCES `sys_user` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `4` FOREIGN KEY (`signature_id`) REFERENCES `gxp_signature` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `CONSTRAINT_1` CHECK (json_valid(`definition_snapshot_json`)),
  CONSTRAINT `CONSTRAINT_2` CHECK (json_valid(`signature_evidence_json`)),
  CONSTRAINT `CONSTRAINT_3` CHECK (`result_conclusion` in ('PASS','FAIL','INVALID')),
  CONSTRAINT `CONSTRAINT_4` CHECK (`revision_no` > 0),
  CONSTRAINT `CONSTRAINT_5` CHECK (`revision_no` = 1 and `previous_revision_id` is null or `revision_no` > 1 and `previous_revision_id` is not null and `reason_for_change` is not null),
  CONSTRAINT `CONSTRAINT_6` CHECK (`result_numeric` is null <> (`result_text` is null))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=11 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci
